description: Get people to watch a video ALL the way through: viewers open it, wait its full length, then answer ONE counting question about it ('how many times does she say X?') that only a viewer can answer. A right answer earns ProductClank points; a wrong first answer gets one more try (watch again). Public, runs exactly 24 hours. Works on any video link (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram Reels, …). COST: nothing now — the user pays 100 credits per CORRECT answer (wrong answers are free) for 24 hours after this chat, for at most max_answers people (default 20 = 2,000 credits max). Needs 100 credits on hand. Before calling: get the questions AND answers from the user (or run suggest_quiz_questions and have them confirm), and confirm max_answers and the maximum spend. Note for the user: paid watch time may count as artificial engagement under the platform's rules. To add a quiz to a boost of the same video, use boost_post's watch_quiz instead.

duration_sec.description: Video length in seconds, or "m:ss". Omit to read it from the TikTok / YouTube page; other platforms need it.

max_answers.description: People who may answer before the quiz closes to new viewers (default 20). Worst case = all of them right = 2,000 credits.

product_id.description: Optional product UUID (from search_products) to name the quiz after.

questions.description: 1–20 questions with their answers. Each viewer draws one. Get them from the user — you cannot watch the video.

question.description: A counting question only someone who watched can answer, e.g. 'How many times does she say "ship"?'

name: create_watch_quiz
title: Create a watch quiz for a video
